test_alignment_methods: test the TokenizersBackend alignment methods including word_ids, token_to_word, word_to_tokens, token_to_chars, char_to_token, char_to_word, word_to_chars, and token_to_sequence
test_offsets_mapping: test that TokenizersBackend returns correct offset_mapping and special_tokens_mask for single and paired inputs
test_training_new_tokenizer: test training a new tokenizer from a small corpus using train_new_from_iterator and verify preserved parameters
test_rust_tokenizer_add_prefix_space: test that the add_prefix_space parameter is correctly propagated to the backend pre-tokenizer
test_decode_encode_roundtrip: test roundtrip encode-decode fidelity across multiple TokenizersBackend v5 models with multilingual text
